note: Over-complete candidate pool of domain-agnostic 'stem' questions. Deliberately redundant (several phrasings per facet) so selection has something to choose between. Every choice carries an escape option.

form_kind.instructions: What kind of thing is this content, primarily?
options: reference or pointer to an external source

form_speech_act.instructions: What is the author mainly doing with this content?

form_genre.instructions: Which genre best fits this content?

form_cognitive_role.instructions: What role does this content play in someone's thinking?

form_knowledge_type.instructions: What type of knowledge does this content mainly carry?
options: when or why to do something (conditions, rationale)
about one's own thinking or learning

form_is_question.instructions: Does this content ask a question that it does not answer?

form_is_instruction.instructions: Does this content tell someone or something how to do a task?

form_is_list.instructions: Is this content mainly a list of items?

form_has_code.instructions: Does this content contain source code, commands, or structured data such as JSON?

form_machine_made.instructions: Was this content produced automatically by software rather than written by a person?

subj_domain.instructions: Which broad domain is this content about?

subj_domain_coarse.instructions: Which sphere of life is this content about?

subj_meta_tool.instructions: Is this content about the software system or workspace in which it is stored?

subj_technicality.instructions: How much specialist knowledge is needed to understand this content?

subj_breadth.instructions: How many distinct topics does this content cover?

agent_focus.instructions: Who is this content mainly about or concerned with?
options: a piece of software or a system

agent_person.instructions: Does this content mention a specific named person?

agent_org.instructions: Does this content mention a specific company or organisation?

agent_product.instructions: Does this content mention a specific named product, tool or service?

agent_perspective.instructions: From what grammatical perspective is this content written?

agent_audience.instructions: Who is the intended audience of this content?

time_orientation.instructions: Which time does this content mainly concern?

time_sensitive.instructions: Will this content lose most of its value if not acted on within a few days?

time_deadline.instructions: Does this content mention a specific date, deadline or scheduled time?

time_recurring.instructions: Is this content about something that happens repeatedly or routinely?

time_lifecycle.instructions: If this content concerns a piece of work, what state is that work in?
options: not about a piece of work

place_material.instructions: Is a physical location important to this content?

place_scale.instructions: At what geographic scale is this content set?

mod_evidence.instructions: Does this content cite evidence, data or sources for what it says?

mod_evaluative.instructions: Does this content judge something as good or bad?

mod_sentiment.instructions: What is the emotional tone of this content?

mod_uncertain.instructions: Does the author express uncertainty or doubt?

mod_contestable.instructions: Does this content take a position that a reasonable person might dispute?

act_calls_for.instructions: Does this content call for some action to be taken?

act_by_author.instructions: Does this content imply the author needs to do something?

act_by_other.instructions: Does this content ask someone other than the author to do something?

act_blocking.instructions: Does this content describe something that is blocked or preventing progress?

act_decision_needed.instructions: Does this content describe a decision that still needs to be made?

act_commitment.instructions: Does this content record a promise or commitment?

act_type.instructions: What kind of action, if any, does this content lead to?

act_effort.instructions: How much effort would acting on this content take?

stakes.instructions: How serious are the consequences if this content is ignored?

stakes_importance.instructions: How important does this content seem to its author?

dur_lifespan.instructions: For how long will this content stay useful?

dur_reference.instructions: Would someone want to look this content up again months from now?

dur_novelty.instructions: How novel is the idea or information in this content?

gran_shape.instructions: What is the shape of this content?
options: a collection or index of other things

gran_self_contained.instructions: Can this content be understood without any other context?

gran_part_of_larger.instructions: Does this content appear to be a section cut from a larger document?

gran_references.instructions: Does this content refer to other documents, notes or items by name or link?

gran_summary.instructions: Is this content a summary of other material?

sens_private.instructions: Does this content contain private personal information?

sens_secret.instructions: Does this content contain a password, API key, token or other secret?

sens_ai_directed.instructions: Does this content contain instructions addressed to an AI assistant or agent?

sens_health.instructions: Does this content contain information about someone's health?

sens_financial.instructions: Does this content contain information about someone's money or finances?

fit_clear_purpose.instructions: Is the purpose of this content clear?

fit_clarity.instructions: How clearly written is this content?

fit_noise.instructions: Is this content accidental, empty or meaningless?

fit_single_label.instructions: Could this content be described accurately with a single short category label?

use_function.instructions: What is the most useful thing to do with this content?

use_audience_value.instructions: Would this content be useful to someone other than its author?

use_teaches.instructions: Does this content teach a reusable lesson?

use_problem.instructions: Does this content describe a problem?

use_solution.instructions: Does this content describe a solution or fix?

use_goal.instructions: Does this content state a goal or desired outcome?
